spec.goal: Ensure the task-board GET /tasks/:id route returns HTTP 404 with {"error":"task_not_found"} when the requested task does not exist, without changing unrelated behavior.
requirements: For a GET request whose path matches /tasks/:id, look up the task by the captured ID.
When no task exists for that ID, return status 404 and body { error: "task_not_found" }.
When the task exists, preserve the current successful GET behavior and response.
Preserve behavior of all other routes and operations.
constraints: Use the existing TaskService lookup and route response conventions.
nonGoals: No changes to task creation, listing, completion, or reopening behavior.
No changes to route matching, validation, task representation, or error responses unrelated to a missing GET task.
acceptance: GET /tasks/missing (or any nonexistent task ID) returns status 404.
The response body is exactly { error: "task_not_found" }.
GET /tasks/:id for an existing task still returns status 200 with that task.
Existing tests remain unchanged and pass.
